dog.description_text:
AGE / WEIGHT: 1.5 years old / 55 lbs

GENDER: Male

ENERGY: Moderate to Active

GOOD WITH: Dogs - Yes, Kids - TBD, Cats - TBD

ABOUT ME: Check my stats: vertical leap, sky-high. Smiles per minute, off the charts. Zoomies, league-leading. I come out of the kennel ready to play, and I greet everyone like they're my new favorite teammate. I'm always up for meeting a new friend, and I know how to take a seat on the bench when it's time. Just say the word, coach. I'm ready.

MY FOSTER SAYS: My story is still being written. Check back soon for updates!

HISTORY

Moneyball wandered up to a home in Georgia as a stray. The family couldn't keep him but offered to foster him. He traveled to Brooklyn in mid-October and will move into a foster home soon.

DETAILED PROFILE

Moneyball has two settings: airborne and grinning. He comes bounding out of his kennel showing off some seriously impressive ups, then greets everyone with jumps, zoomies, and a huge smile. Nobody gets a lukewarm hello from this guy.

He wandered up to a home in Georgia as a young dog, and the family fostered him until our rescue partner had room.

Other dogs pick up on his happy vibes. They all come straight to his kennel to say hello through the fence, all casual and easy. When he met one of them in person he was eager to say hi, and when she wasn't up for his enthusiasm, he backed off and settled right down.

House and crate training, leash skills, energy at home, kids and cats: those numbers aren't in yet. His foster will start keeping score once he moves out of boarding and into a foster home.

He'll do best with someone who enjoys an active routine, doesn't mind a little work on polite greetings, and wants a dog who treats every hello like a walk-off home run.

MEDICAL HISTORY

The dogs in our care are up-to-date on vaccinations, spayed or neutered (when old enough), microchipped, and given a general health check. Immediate medical needs and medical history will be addressed with the adopter prior to adoption. Complete vet records will be sent shortly after adoption.
dog.name: MONEYBALL
